verdict.rationale: Lambda's public pricing page (lambda.ai/pricing) explicitly lists per-GPU-hour prices (e.g., B200 SXM6 at $6.69/hr) with no sales contact required for on-demand/self-serve instances, and is described as 'Clear, straightforward pricing.' Missing for 10: evidence of the full price list covering every GPU type (only one example price shown) and independent/hands-on confirmation that all listed GPUs' hourly rates are public rather than 'contact us' (which does appear for reserved capacity).
